name: Search and open product details
description: Verifies the main discovery workflow opens a detailed product view with price history and store offers.
steps: Enter Samsung S25 Ultra in the main search field
Press Подробнее on the Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 256GB card
Review the product detail modal and browser hash
expected: The Samsung product detail opens with demo price history, offers from 220.lv, Dateks.lv and Samsung.lv, and the URL hash identifies the product.

name: Enable alert and use alerts quick view
description: Verifies a user can enable a price alert, see its counter, and filter the catalog to alerted products.
steps: Open details for Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 256GB and enable the price alert
Close the detail view and press the bell counter in the header
expected: The alert counter reflects the saved alert, only alerted products are shown in the quick view, and the alert remains saved after refresh.

name: Use favorites quick view and copy product link
description: Verifies favorite products can be isolated and a direct product URL can be copied from details.
steps: Add Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 256GB to favorites and press the heart counter in the header
expected: The quick view shows the favorite product, the detail URL contains its product hash, and a visible confirmation reports that the link was copied.

name: Filter and enforce comparison limit
description: Verifies catalog filters work and comparison rejects more than three products.
steps: Select Samsung.lv and lower the maximum price, then reset the filters
Add three different products to comparison
Try to add a fourth product
expected: Filters narrow and restore the catalog, comparison remains at 3/3, and a visible maximum-three message appears for the fourth product.

name: Switch language and use product details on mobile
description: Verifies the Latvian interface and product details remain usable on a phone-sized viewport.
steps: Tap LV in the language switch
Review and close the product detail sheet
expected: The interface is in Latvian, the detail sheet is readable without horizontal overflow, and it can be closed.
